LanguageData.DMS_Turret_LightMachineGun.label: mech LMG
LanguageData.DMS_Turret_LightMachineGun.description:
A weapon specializing in suppression chambered in a large caliber rifle round.
This weapon is specially designed for automatroid use, normal humans will struggle to use it without external equipment or augmentations.
Its folding bipod lets a drafted operator drop it into a firing position on the spot, and pick it back up just as quickly.
